steps.rule: RS-3 on a 25 ft lot: 2 units allowed if >= 60% of buildings on the same block face have 2+ units (lot area per unit becomes 1500)
steps.data: units per building on the block face from x54s-btds char_apts and class codes; verify the 1,500 sq ft figure against the code

steps.rule: +1 unit (coach house or conversion) in RT-4 and higher and B/C; RS where the city's ADU eligibility map allows (permanent since 2026-04-01); 2+ ADUs trigger affordability rule
recompute at a target district the user picks; default is the first target listed
within 0.5 mi of CTA rail station or 0.25 mi of eligible bus corridor: car parking 0, bike parking 1 per unit
steps.data: use the city transit-served location map if published; otherwise CTA rail and Metra stations plus eligible bus corridors. CTA rail alone undercounts.

steps.rule: by right only in B2 and DR; other B/C districts flag special use or adjustment
flag Affordable Requirements Ordinance when a rezoning scenario reaches 10+ units
historic orange/red rating (90-day demolition hold), 606/Pilsen demolition surcharge district, fire limits (wood frame mostly not allowed)
